system.name: Place3D
system.one_liner: A full-cycle pipeline that scores multi-LiDAR placements with the M-SOG metric, optimises them by evolution, and tests them on a new multi-condition dataset.

content.variant_note: three tinted dashed regions: blue for the M-SOG metric (a to c), red for the optimiser (d), a grey bottom band for the verification chain (baseline, CARLA, e, f)
content.argues: A semantic-occupancy entropy metric computed from simulated scenes can drive an evolutionary search for LiDAR placements, which are then validated on a new multi-condition dataset.
content.subject: a driving scene turned into occupancy grids and covered voxels, an M-SOG landscape searched by evolution, then CARLA data, model training and evaluation

lessons.what_to_learn: Give each phase of a multi-phase method its own tinted dashed region and keep that hue on heading, captions and arrows; let a curved arrow carry the result across regions, and zoom a heat-map point into the search loop that produces it.
lessons.suits: multi-phase engineering pipelines (design search, simulator data, downstream evaluation) where a metric, an optimiser and a verification chain must be told apart.

evidence: We first utilize the semantic point cloud synthesized in CARLA (a) to generate Probabilistic SOG (b)
We propose a CMA-ES-based optimization strategy to maximize M-SOG, finding optimal LiDAR placement (d).
we contribute a multi-condition multi-LiDAR dataset (e) and evaluate the performance of baselines and optimized placements

summary: Place3D is a full-cycle pipeline for multi-LiDAR placement: it scores sensor layouts with the Surrogate Metric of Semantic Occupancy Grids (M-SOG), optimises them with a CMA-ES strategy, and checks them on a new multi-condition dataset. The figure is built from three tinted dashed regions. The blue region walks lettered stages from CARLA scene layers through a probabilistic occupancy volume to covered voxels and entropy; the red region shows the optimiser as a heat-map landscape zoomed into a loop of red dots; a grey bottom band chains captioned icons from baseline placements through CARLA, the dataset and model training to evaluation.
